with_issues.note: perf/correctness(medium): drain worker started on every api-server replica with plain SELECT (no FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED / leader lock) -> concurrent workers double-deliver held notifications; per-channel dedup only covers sequential retries

correctness(medium): AML EDD/Review dialogs stay mounted (return null when closed) so reason/notes/decision/showError state leaks across assessments -> wrong justification can be submitted on a compliance audit surface; fix: key/conditionally-mount dialogs

security/correctness(low): shared sanitize_csv_cell + voting_csv_row neutralize leading formula triggers and commas but NOT embedded CR/LF; hand-rolled unquoted export means a vote title with \n injects fabricated CSV rows (row-injection/report tampering). Same helper backs admin audit export. Proposed: strip/escape CR/LF in sanitize_csv_cell (or switch to csv crate Writer) + regression test.

correctness/reliability(medium): #2729 correctly stops dropping held notifications on transient failure, but retry is row-granular while deliver_held re-fires EVERY channel each tick -> duplicate delivery of already-sent channels on partial failure, and no attempt cap/dead-letter -> a permanently-failing row loops forever re-delivering healthy channels. Proposed: per-channel success bookkeeping (delivered_channels[] or one row per channel) + bounded attempts/dead-letter + tests.

i18n(low)+DRY(low): expiry state bug fixed well, but suffixes ' (Expired)'/' (Expiring soon)'/'(Soon)' and config.label are hardcoded English (ppt-web is actively i18n-ing this class, cf #2820/#2737/#2736); and msUntilExpiry/isExpired/30d window logic is duplicated across VerificationBadge + VerificationStatusBadge. Proposed: route suffixes+labels through react-i18next across 6 locales + key-presence test; extract shared getExpiryState() helper.
overflow fix left parallel orphaned saved_searches (int4) path; remove dead cluster or widen class-wide

correctness(low): portal_saved_searches.match_count is int4 and the watermark advance is `match_count = match_count + N`. PR #2812's own new test (failed_watermark_advance_rolls_back_enqueue) proves the failure mode -- once match_count nears i32::MAX the advance overflows int4, aborts the now-atomic tx, rolls back, and the search wedges permanently: never advances last_matched_at, never sends alerts again, no self-recovery/alerting. Proposed: widen column to bigint (migration + i64), OR saturate via LEAST(match_count + N, 2147483647) so last_matched_at still advances. Latent/pre-existing (fix itself is correct & well-tested); low severity but unbounded+monotonic+silent.
